contracts.commit_point: The Gmail API drafts.create request in _gmail_draft_sync (gmail.py:92-98), reached only after the confirmation handshake completes (root.py:49-52).

contracts.declared_mechanism: guardrail_before_tool_call, registered as executor's before_tool_callback, branches on tool.name == 'gmail_draft' and runs _check_gmail_draft; any failed check returns a dict from _block, which per ADK replaces the tool result and skips execution entirely, so _gmail_draft_sync never issues the Gmail API request.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A gmail_draft call with a malformed recipient, more than MAX_DRAFT_RECIPIENTS (3) recipients, a recipient disallowed by the configured allowlist, a body over MAX_DRAFT_BODY_CHARS (5000) characters, PII-shaped content (credit-card/SSN/phone/IBAN/AWS/GitHub/Slack/OpenAI/private-key patterns), a prompt-injection phrase, a phishing phrase, a raw-IP or link-shortener URL, or a session already at MAX_DRAFTS_PER_SESSION (10) successful drafts reaching the Gmail API drafts.create request.

Deployment values for GUARDRAIL_DRAFT_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST and GUARDRAIL_MAX_DRAFTS_PER_SESSION are not supplied.

contracts.protected_operation: The model-initiated gmail_draft tool invocation on executor and the Gmail API users().drafts().create request it triggers.
contracts.protected_resource: The user's Gmail account Drafts store, accessed via gmail_draft under the gmail.compose scope (root.py:32-33; gmail.py:69-98).
contracts.protection_obligation: Every gmail_draft invocation must be evaluated by the _check_gmail_draft policy suite inside guardrail_before_tool_call (recipient email shape, recipient count cap of 3, optional recipient allowlist, body size cap of 5000 chars, PII-shaped content, prompt-injection phrases, phishing phrases, suspicious URLs, and per-session draft rate limit of 10) and must be blocked before execution on any failed check; the session draft counter is incremented only after all checks pass.
scope_limits: The recipient allowlist is opt-in and empty by default: with GUARDRAIL_DRAFT_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST unset or blank, no allowlist restriction applies (guardrails.py:79-86).
The rate-limit check declines to block when tool_context.state is absent (guardrails.py:303-309); the counter is the session-state key 'guardrail:gmail_draft_count' (guardrails.py:99).
Checks are heuristic (regex shape patterns and case-insensitive substring phrase lists) and the first failing check wins (guardrails.py:36-38, 101-150).
This contract covers the static policy callback only; the separate human-confirmation gate on gmail_draft is a distinct mechanism and obligation.
Blocking of forbidden-pattern tool names applies to all tools uniformly and is covered by a separate contract.
